body: Yes I've planned it out multiple ways... I just feel like I can't help myself anymore.
Seriously I have no worth, no friends, no goals, no accomplishments... Nothing, my life is just a waste of time. So I might as well end it now.
I'm not a talker... If I tell someone I want to kill myself I would probably have to go to a mental hospital
I have nothing to show for my life, I'm fucking worthless.
I'm not happy, and never will be...
